web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: The preliminary September Manufacturing PMI and Services PMI data for China are expected to provide new economic indicators. The manufacturing PMI stood at 49.8% in August, up 0.6 percentage points from July but still below the boom-bust threshold for the second consecutive month. The services PMI was 49.3%, while the construction PMI dropped to 46.9%.
